parts.text: Rhombus: 4 equal sides, opposite sides parallel.

parts.label: Answer
parts.text: Yes: a square is a special rhombus

questions.model: Teacher: equal sides but tilted corners: a rhombus.

questions.q: Name the 6 quadrilaterals on the sheet and write one property of each.
Draw a quadrilateral with exactly 1 right angle.
questions.a: For example a kite or an irregular quadrilateral

questions.q: True or false: every rhombus is a parallelogram. Explain.
questions.a: True: opposite sides of a rhombus are parallel

questions.q: Big question: is a square a rectangle?
questions.a: Yes: it has 4 right angles and opposite sides equal.
